Tax expense for the year comprises current and deferred tax.
Current tax
The tax currently payable is based on taxable profit for the year. Taxable profit differs from profit before tax for the year as reported in the Statement of Profit and Loss because it excludes items of income or expense that are taxable or deductible in other years and it further excludes items that are never taxable or deductible. The Company’s liability for current tax is calculated using tax rates and tax laws that have been enacted or substantively enacted in the country where the Company operates by the end of the reporting period.
Deferred tax
  Deferred tax liabilities are the amount of income taxes payable in future periods in respect of taxable temporary differences. Deferred tax assets are the amount of income tax recoverable in in future in respect of deductible temporary differences, carry forward of unused tax losses and carry forward of unused tax credits. timeline.summary: 28 Apr 2026: Acuité reaffirmed MSTC's ACUITE A+ (Stable) long-term and A1+ short-term ratings on ₹110 Cr of bank facilities, with no change.
On May 28, 2026, MSTC disclosed that BSE levied a fine of ₹5.31 lakh for non-compliance with board composition rules for Q4 FY26.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹118.8 Cr (+33.7% YoY), net profit ₹77.22 Cr (+2.3% YoY) (Q4FY25 includes ₹1.62 Cr from discontinued operations).
Ajay Kumar Rai, Dy. Manager (Listing), shared the audio recording of the investor conference call on 30.05.2026 discussing Q4FY26 and FY26 performance via Mstc Limited’s website.
Mstc Limited reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹370 Cr and EBITDA of ₹307.49 Cr during its earnings call on May 30, 2026.
